rtl.scope: Whole single-worker scratch search loop in RTL, seeded by testbench and using commit C-model snapshots. Nine small directed reference differential cases; no full native graph, async ownership, implementation timing or board proof

failure_rtl.scope: Directed failure branches of controller RTL; producer C-model for valid/overflow states, explicit fault injection for malformed inputs. No full native or asynchronous protocol proof

random_cmodel.scope: Randomized CPU differential only; no random RTL, native full graph or asynchronous authority proof

joint_fixture_xrt.scope: Whole-search CU using actual commit-owned resources, device authority byte preservation checks, consumed-read invalidation and path publication; serialized small fixture with negotiated overuse, not legal full-design route, asynchronous protocol or board proof

native_cross_cmodel.scope: Native actual-top C-model execution with independent dictionary resource costs and internal exact path/ordered-read assertions; auditor checks provenance and completion, does not independently replay exported paths

multiseed_cmodel.scope: Native actual-top C-model execution with independent dictionary resource costs and internal exact path/ordered-read assertions; auditor checks provenance and completion, does not independently replay exported paths

native_commit.scope: Independent complete tree/membership, resource occupancy/history/version and revision replay of native path commit; no concurrency or board claim

atomic_rejection.scope: Injected version mismatch and invalid PIP rejected with full authority byte assertions; corrected replay byte-equal to independently audited clean native commit

group_metadata.scope: Actual final memory and allocation group metadata, not host BO allocation or native XRT search execution

allocation.scope: Actual XRT runtime groups, simultaneous full bounded BO allocations and synthetic cross-bank readbacks; no native payload upload or CU execution

native_smoke_xrt.scope: Actual seed/search CU execution on full native graph and imported audited authority; byte-identical to C-model path/observations with independent path replay

sharded_commit_rtl.scope: Three-owner resource pointer commit RTL byte-differential against unchanged flat C-model, with logical capacity1 and guarded padded physical test backing; no platform bank allocation, concurrent owners or routed timing claim

sharded_read_rtl.scope: Distinct owner pointer reader RTL with actual banked-commit C-model snapshot producer; no physical bank placement, concurrent coherence, full-capacity RTL or routed timing proof

sharded_joint_xrt.scope: Actual banked commit/seed/whole-search CUs, shared owner BOs, runtime group checks, full authority preservation assertions and stale-read rejection/path publication; serialized small fixture with negotiated overuse
